title: Batch 4 originals lane: Rome Urbanian original, Iberian historic uses, Italian local uses, OCSO and batch-3 originals

uses.finding: Inspected an original Rome Typographia Vaticana 1635 printing of the Urban VIII Missal (Google XNC4a07qPqQC): title, Si quid est dated 2 September 1634, a Congregation of Rites decree extract ordered for the new printing, register and colophon; it now witnesses roman-stages-1634 and adds one concrete preliminary-rubric change against Rome 1604. Added the 1951 and 1952 experimental Easter Vigil stages with a six-locus documented revision from AAS 43/44.
uses.limit: No 1634-dated imprint located or inspected; body text of 1604/1635 uncollated; AAS texts are gazette renditions.
uses.next_sources: A 1634-dated Vatican copy if one exists; UB [1634?] preliminaries; 1956 TPV Holy Week book; 2020 Supplementum.

uses.finding: No new digitized curial ordinal or pre-Pian comparison source; van Dijk/Walker 1975 located only in print.
uses.limit: archive.org was unreachable during the fork's searches.
uses.next_sources: van Dijk–Walker, HBS 85, Lippe 1907; Legg 1571 Varisco copy.

uses.finding: Original 1498 Hurus (Toledo Inc. 248) and 1522 Coci (BUZ H-1-152) copies inspected; two documented stages and one holy-day-list revision.
uses.limit: The 1522 copy is catalogued 1540; only the holy-day list is collated.
uses.next_sources: Another 1485 copy; 1522 edition copies; 1552 Bernuz; Roman adoption.

uses.finding: Original 1509 Giunta and 1528 Coci copies inspected; two documented stages and one January-calendar revision.
uses.limit: Low-resolution images; 1492 incunable unseen.
uses.next_sources: BNE or Valencia copy of 1492; Esteve Forriol 1992.

uses.finding: 1499 Rosembach edition identified (GW M24774) and its BVPB digitization located but unreachable (HTTP 429 throughout).
uses.limit: No original leaf viewed beyond a cached thumbnail.

uses.finding: No Urgell incunable in GW and no digitization in CCPB, MDC, Europeana or Zaguán.
uses.limit: Absence from repertories is not absence of printing.

uses.finding: Copy census (Seo de Zaragoza; Hispanic Society) and a cross-check placing Lambert's quoted supplication in Zaragoza 1485 one folio earlier; no digitized original.
uses.limit: Original 1488 book unacquired; defective-tail supplement unresolved.
uses.next_sources: Hispanic Society or Seo de Zaragoza images; amiet-usuarium-7335 (1504 Osca-Jaca).

uses.finding: The 1529 Coci printing is digitized (Zaguán 749, ~507 MB DjVu, not opened); a further undated copy at Palacio Larrinaga.
uses.limit: No new 1500 evidence.

uses.finding: BnF catalogue records a 1625 Augustin Potier missal (B-781), probably the predecessor named in the mandate by the bishop's name (an unverified match, not a catalogue statement), and earlier 1514/1520/1538 printings; the c. 1290 cathedral manuscript is a separate lead.
uses.limit: Catalogue level only; nothing inspected.
uses.next_sources: BnF B-781 title and mandate leaves.

uses.finding: BnF catalogue lists 1497, 1551, 1694 and 1769 items; Vesoul γ 130 (1508) is reported digitized but its host was unreachable.
uses.limit: Zero public image payloads kept, as previously decided.

uses.finding: BnF lists Toul missals 1493–1630, Toul Missale Romanum 1638/1718 and Nancy-Toul 1838/1860 items, none digitized.
uses.limit: Catalogue only.
uses.next_sources: BnF copies of 1551 and 1630; 1860 SRC-revised propers.

uses.finding: BnF confirms 1509 and 1540 printings matching existing leads.
uses.limit: Ghent catalogue unreachable.

uses.finding: ULiège 1499 copies preserve the a1 title leaf (other-copy evidence for the leaf the BSB catalogue reports missing); a 22 July 1540 Paris issue is documented as a stage with appended Masses.
uses.limit: No 1499 → 1540 transition asserted; 1540 issues not reconciled.
uses.next_sources: Cockx-Indestege et al. 1997; BnF Liège copies.

uses.finding: 1494 colophon (Ratdolt, 23 December 1494) and 1517 BSB colophon (Pentius for Oswald, 16 September 1517) read; the Liechtenstein 1517 is a separate edition.
uses.limit: Bodies uncollated; one calendar difference recorded as observation only.

uses.finding: Cathedral cod. 21 (Amiet cod. S) local Ordo documented and linked to the 1617 Pian Ordo substitution at scholarly-description level.
uses.limit: 1617 book and decree unread; manuscript known through Amiet only.

uses.finding: No digitization of VI.33 or VI.29 found.
uses.limit: Usuarium timed out.

uses.finding: Rylands 1480 incipit and colophon read; USTC identifies the 1499–1568 editions.
uses.limit: Incipit names the Gallici, not Messina; later editions catalogue only.

uses.finding: No digitization of H14, the 2001 edition or the sacramentaries; a museum display lead for the 1578 Borromeo letter.
uses.limit: Lead only; handwriting illegible.

uses.finding: Composite index retained; no sequence manufactured.
uses.limit: Child routes own the books.

uses.finding: No facsimile or edition text of E 57 or D 30 found; IRHT timed out.
uses.limit: Padua kept distinct from Passau Pataviense.

uses.finding: Archive 011 and the 1454 Ursiana missal web-searched without result; fragment critical editions not searched in this batch.
uses.limit: Three Ravenna fragment gaps not attempted.

uses.finding: Published 8 June 1971 Ordo particularities and 31 August 1972 calendar confirmations added as stages; 1966–1969 confirmations of OCSO vernacular proper texts and the lectionary DOC title narrow the gaps.
uses.limit: Signed instruments and the Latin books remain unseen; Prot. number and date discrepancies retained.
